response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), scored AS (SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, AVG(spatial_count) OVER () AS average_count, SUM(spatial_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, spatial_count::numeric / total_count AS share, spatial_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM scored WHERE spatial_count > average_count;

assumptions.assumption: Projects with NULL fundflux have no known funding source and are excluded from the counts and their total.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL fundflux as one funding-source group.
